title: Phoenix SDR-DSP: Windows-Native DSP, SDR, and PQC Experiments for AMD Phoenix XDNA1
description: A native Windows 11 research corpus for deterministic DSP, SDR, transform, and FIPS-aligned post-quantum cryptography experiments on AMD Ryzen AI Phoenix silicon. The v1.0.1-rc.4 snapshot adds audited third-party provenance, retained NIST ACVP notices, and GitHub-compatible mathematical notation.
